title: Request a slot on a shared test environment
summary: The old way to get a test environment: book one of the five shared virtual machines for up to two weeks. Retired - test environments are now namespaces on the Kubernetes test cluster.

prerequisites.title: Test plan
prerequisites.description: What you will test and for how long.

actors.name: You
actors.description: The tester or engineer who needs the environment.

steps.title: Raise the 'Test environment slot' request
instructions: Enter the start date and the number of days, at most 10.

steps.title: Deploy your build to the environment
instructions: Copy your build to the machine named in the request.
Run the install script from the environment's wiki page.

steps.title: Give the environment back
instructions: Remove your data from the machine.
